title: Asymmetric bets
idea: Pascal argued that you should weigh the size of the payoffs, not only the odds. A small cost for a huge possible gain can be worth taking even at low probability.
apply: Before you decline a long shot, ask what it costs if it fails and what it is worth if it works. Take cheap bets you can afford to lose.
remind: Small cost, huge upside: take the bet.
who: Sana, who admires an author but fears emailing her.

items.x: She wants one piece of advice

scenes.nar: Sana admires a well known author and wants one piece of advice from her. But she assumes the author would never reply.
The odds are low, maybe one in ten. But the cost of trying is one short email, and the value of a reply could be large.

items: Take it, even at low odds

scenes.nar: Pascal weighed payoffs, not just odds. When the cost is small and the possible gain is huge, a low chance can still be a good bet. Sana writes the email.

items.x: The author replies in two weeks
A call that changes her plans

scenes.nar: She sends three sentences and one clear question. Two weeks later the author replies, and the call that follows changes her plans.
